artboards.title: Build to Bond · desktop 1440 · v2 in the kit and impact family

annotations.text:
Build to Bond page v2 — the justice programme page, redesigned in the same family as the kit and impact pages.
WHAT CHANGES: (1) the why-it-works image becomes THE FILM — the Lowdham Grange edit (v15, subtitled, blur-audited to zero face exposures), as the estate's signature player: duotone poster, lime ticket, breathing play button, plays inline with sound; (2) hero gains the titleblock ('runs in four UK prisons · accredited two OCN Level 2 courses'); (3) the six weeks become the culm timeline with pictograms, the device impact uses for its stations; (4) the three course cards, which were EMPTY on the live page, are filled — exact OCN titles and course IDs, a cleared prison still and a pictogram stamp each; (5) the credibility band gains the recognition chips; (6) breadcrumb becomes Home / Build to Bond; 'Fund a cohort' now goes to support-mission; (7) counts of 2 September: four sites, 14 staff, 10+ peer mentors.
KEPT AS LIVE: film-loop hero (jig reel, no faces), fork cards, story, stats, staff quote, commissioning steps, where it runs, case card, CTA. Every colour, size and border is the live theme's; all copy is Claims Register wording.

GATE BEFORE LIVE: the film names HMP Lowdham Grange and was produced by the prison's Inside Media Department. The blur audit is complete, but the vault records no written press-office clearance (Wayne Peters, via Sally Allsopp). Built on the preview theme; goes live on James's word that clearance is in hand.
